notes: TypeScript preparedRender assembles actual source scanner/parser/evaluator primitives; it is not the unchanged render.ts entrypoint.

rounds.response: Corrected in core, with two independently added regression tests and 36 source-oracle cases; existing 3527 source facts and 16 benchmark definitions unchanged.

rounds.scope: Bounded independent recheck of UTF16 memo keys, enumerable event-data spread and explicit syntax selection against actual TypeScript source.

red.sourceFacts: Actual isolated TypeScript oracle probes and unchanged source calls support both added assertions.

review.limitations: Source-traced independent review; Rust runtime verification and release timings are supplied by lead capped-compiler receipts.

cleanup.images: No task image was built; shared pinned compiler image retained.
cleanup.networksAndVolumes: Compiler used the existing bridge for bootstrap and was disconnected for runtime checks. No task network or named volume was created; every compiler was removed with --volumes and all cleanup receipts have no errors.

concurrentTemporaryRunObservation.observation: Three temporary container names appeared intermittently during finalization captures. Read-only labels identify separate API run api-3105c1e7b20c. The evaluator did not create, remove or deploy them. Their lifecycle is independent of this task; production.newContainers records the artifact capture.
